Chapter 6932: A Chance

Chapter 6932: A Chance

Timeflow shuddered again upon seeing the death of five immortals. Li Qiye never failed to impress him more and more each time.

He imagined that Li Qiye could obliterate the galaxy in one move. Immortals seemed helpless before him.

To the world, everything below the immortal realm was insignificant, overlords included. Now, whatever Li Qiye was, he reigned above immortals.

“Who are you?!” A roar swept through the debris, shattering space and time.

The broken fragments came together and the galaxy became whole again, improved with a fiery radiance. A celestial old man could be seen, wearing a silk robe made of stars.

When he opened his eyes, he revealed the boundless cosmo with untold potential for destruction.

“Perpetual Immortal.” Timeflow’s expression changed since he heard notorious tales before. However, he didn’t fear the man while hiding behind Li Qiye.

“Bestowment’s disciple.” Perpetual glared at Timeflow. Bestowment was the title of Timeflow’s master.

“You?” Perpetual thought this at first but Timeflow didn’t have this power.

“Not me, it’s the great immortal.” Timeflow continued to hide.

Perpetual didn’t notice Li Qiye at first due to his cultivation. The guy was no different than a speck of dust.

“You killed my generals?” He activated his heavenly gaze and became puzzled.

“Those five insects? Yes.” Li Qiye said nonchalantly.

“May I ask who you are, Sir?” He was no fool and changed his tone.

“Just a passerby who will take your life today.” Li Qiye said.

“What have I done to warrant your wrath?” He found this humiliating but kept calm.

He didn’t recall having an enemy like Li Qiye. Of course, he had no lack of enemies due to his bloody path. However, they were too weak to be considered enemies.

“You have sealed two women from Guardian Alliance.” Li Qiye said.

“Sir, I never did such a thing.” His expression soured.

Accusing him of destroying worlds was fine. After all, that wouldn’t be lies. However, times were different about the potential imprisonment.

Admitting this meant antagonizing Guardian Alliance. This alliance has grown strong enough to destroy his branch. Although this alliance was generally reasonable, the accused crime demanded retribution.

“Release them and your death will be swift. Otherwise, a tragic fate awaits you.” Li Qiye said.

“Mind your words since it is absolutely not true.” He said.

Kidnapping members of Guardian was one thing, but to do so from those who had just arrived from the nine worlds? This was taboo, as it served as a reminder of the alliance’s darkest period.

“I had reservations about destroying a whole branch, but it looks like you won’t cry until you see the coffin. Now, I’m more than happy to do so.” Li Qiye revealed a gentle smile.

“Your arrogance knows no bounds. Even if you are from Guardian, you'd best think twice before attacking us.” He raised his voice.

“You have a chance to attack first.” Li Qiye said.

His complexion changed several times, wondering if a mortal could somehow kill him.

“Excuse me then.” He decided to go all-out.
